plot_scene: plot a 3D scene with object pointclouds and an optional pointmap mesh using Plotly
plot_multi_objects: plot multiple 3D objects with named poses, colors, and an optional pointmap in a single scene
object_pointcloud: transform local 3D points into a world-space PyTorch3D pointcloud using quaternion rotation, translation, and scale
pointmap_to_mesh: convert a pointmap tensor and image tensor into a textured 3D mesh with filtered edges
pointmap_to_pointcloud: convert a pointmap tensor and optional image tensor into a PyTorch3D pointcloud structure
